# GATE_PROFILE.md — <gate name>

> Run produced by `/gate-recon` on \<date\>. Facts carry URL + access date. UNKNOWN is honest; a guessed fact is a landmine.

```text
GATE:
  name: <event / launch / grant / pitch>
  who decides: <sponsors' engineers / VC panel / algorithm / judges given rubric>
  what they see: <devpost page / 3-min demo / deck / live product>
  how fast they decide: <30 seconds / 3 minutes / a week>
  what makes them say yes: <...>
  what makes them say no: <...>
  state: open / closed / coming  (dates: ...)

PATTERNS WE CAN APPLY:            # from the winners, each with URL + date
  - <pattern>  (<url>, <date>)
PATTERNS WE WILL NOT COPY:        # from the corpses, each with URL + date
  - <pattern>  (<url>, <date>)

RUBRIC (published or default weights):
  - <criterion>: <weight>        # mark "default" if not published

UNKNOWNS:                         # every UNKNOWN is Gate 2's job
  - <unknown>  (who will resolve it, how)
```
